pointer_source: Ruby Advisory Database / candidate survey (metadata only)

kept_files.note: RubyDataSource#load_timezone_info is upstream-verbatim: the identifier check (the one anchored expression the fix commit changed), the gsub/split transform and the require of the matching definition file via require_definition/require_data are exactly the code the fix commit touched and the loader path it reaches

stand_ins.replaces: the constructor that locates the bundled tzinfo-data gem
stand_ins.with: an initializer that takes the data directory as its argument
stand_ins.note: supplies the base path the require resolves against; it performs no loading and decides nothing about the identifier

reduction_removed: RubyDataSource index/country methods and the const_get resolution of the loaded definition, unrelated to the identifier check and loader path

the module-level RubyCoreSupport refinement and the .untaint calls (a deprecated no-op on the ruby31 runtime, removed in Ruby 3.2), dropped identically from both variants; unrelated to the identifier check
pov_note: Benign control and proof-of-vulnerability probes authored by the Corsair chain at run time; none authored here. Property observable in-process: an identifier that passes the check reaches require of a file resolved relative to the data directory, so a crafted identifier loads a file outside that directory (one variant) or is rejected before the require (the other). No outbound network.
